release_read.basis: Revenue $1.52B beat both bars ($1.51B Benzinga, $1.46B MarketBeat) but mostly on FX (cc merchandise +7.8%, cc comps +6.2%, decelerating from 6.9% in Q3); EPS $1.21 is in line-to-slightly-short of $1.22 and short of MarketBeat's $1.27, and operating income grew only ~8% ($57.0M vs $52.8M) so margin slipped; on a name that sold its last beat this reads mildly negative, well inside the 4.49% median reaction.

release.headline: PriceSmart, Inc. announces results of operations for the fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026 (8-K exhibit 99.1, dated 2026-10-26, after the close; exact minute not read)

key_line.detail: Comps +12.2% reported, +6.2% constant currency (Q3 was +6.9% cc); operating income $57.0M vs $52.8M (+8%), net income +19.3% to $37.6M; adjusted EBITDA $83.5M vs $75.5M. Nasdaq EPS forecast in the brief is null (2 estimates).

call.time_et: 2026-10-27 morning per company scheduling not verified
call.detail: Call content not read in the time available.

thesis_check.note: The PSU vest correctly signalled no bad year and revenue cleared, but EPS landed at the low/middle of a disputed bar and cc comps decelerated; the thesis that the max vest meant a clear beat is not confirmed on EPS.

expected.open_lag_note: Placeholder before the tape: amc print had the night, so the open should hold the pre-market move; small gap, no strong fade prior.

recommendation.reason: De omzet was beter dan verwacht, maar vooral door gunstige valutakoersen; de winst per aandeel lag rond of iets onder de verwachting. Er is geen reden om van de standaardregel af te wijken: verkoop bij de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Een duidelijke stijging voorbeurs met veel handel en positieve analistenreacties zou vasthouden tot later in de dag kunnen rechtvaardigen.
